svg.title: Anatomy of an orbiter
svg.desc: Each orbiter circles a centre that drifts slowly and bounces off the edges. Its radius is 20 to 180 pixels, its angle grows by the global speed times its own factor, and its size is 4 to 12 pixels. Every frame the canvas is washed at alpha 45, the orbiters move and are drawn, and one more is added every 6 frames while the mouse is held.
